periods.time: Final day of the Seven Stars Festival
periods.label: 协助一辉调整的雷切

status.current: helps Ikki prepare, observes the final, and has her entrusted school flag raised by him

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former selection-final opponent; responds to his request and pressures him seriously in a tuning match.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Friend who covers for her delayed arrival to the student council group.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Peer-level helper in Ikki's preparation gauntlet.

periods.summary: Toka delays joining the student council because Ikki asks her to help him prepare. In the training ring she exploits the weakness of Ikki's Edelweiss-derived movement by alternating Raio shots, then forces him into close-range swordplay with her Denkou-accelerated counters and threatens Raikiri. Ikki defeats her by using battlefield debris to jam Narukami's sheath, and Toka recognizes his broader battlefield intelligence. At the award ceremony, the Hagun flag she entrusted to Ikki is handed to him so he can raise it from the champion podium.

key_events.summary: Spars with Ikki and forces him to improvise against Denkou and Raikiri.
Her entrusted Hagun flag becomes the symbol Ikki raises as champion.

periods.time: Ikki's victory party at Ittousei after Seven Stars
periods.label: 迈向A级联盟的雷切

status.current: plans to train over summer and enter Japan's National League after graduation
status.condition: frustrated she never fought Moroboshi but motivated by Ikki and Stella's level

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Friendly rival; they discuss the anti-Hahakiboshi technique and promise to meet in higher leagues.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Junior whose victory pushes her to re-evaluate her own immaturity.
relationships.nango-torajiro: Teacher she plans to train under during summer.

periods.summary: Toka attends Ikki's victory party and discusses with Moroboshi the match they never had. She confirms that her electromagnetic sword technique Raikou was refined partly to counter Moroboshi's Hahakiboshi, and the two jokingly argue over who would have won. After seeing Ikki and Stella's final, Toka realizes she is still immature and plans to spend summer retraining under her master before entering the domestic league and aiming for the A-League.

key_events.summary: Discusses future professional paths with Moroboshi.

periods.time: After Japan's special conscription ends and during her return to Fukuoka
periods.label: 守护若叶之家并遭遇大炎
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Wakaba House; Todo family

status.current: discovers that the kind old man she helped is Harima Tendo, the escaped Great Flame
status.condition: emotionally shaken after trying to protect her foster family and then seeing Tendo's true ideology

relationships.utakata-misogi: Childhood friend from Wakaba House who returns with her and challenges her thinking.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Childhood friend and benefactor's daughter who supports Wakaba House and mediates social conflict.
relationships.toshiko-nishikata: Foster mother and Wakaba House director whose exhaustion makes Toka determined to protect the home.
relationships.harima-tendo: Initially a starving blind elder whom Toka respects; revealed as Great Flame after he reacts to her chamomile story.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Rival she still regrets not rematching before he leaves for China.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Potential opponent whom she believes she can beat due to matchup advantages.

periods.summary: Toka finishes special conscription, trains at the League branch, observes Kuraudo's spar with Moroboshi, and then returns to Fukuoka with Uta and Kanata. At Wakaba House she learns that local parents led by Mrs. Ito have spread rumors, encouraged bullying, locked the trash area and harassed the orphanage. Toka initially wants to solve the problem by staying home and using her standing and power, but the blind elder Harima Tendo advises mutual understanding through volunteer work and greetings. His approach helps the children reconcile with their bullies, teaching Toka that she had been too quick to rely on force. At her parents' grave she shares the chamomile flower-language memory that shaped her ideal of becoming a supportive adult. The story triggers Harima's fanatic revelation as Great Flame; Toka instantly attacks with Raikiri, but he blocks it with Ama no Murakumo.

key_events.summary: Discusses Ikki's heroic rise and plans to return to Kyushu.
Analyzes the matchup and Kuraudo's growth.
Confronts neighborhood harassment and learns a nonviolent path to reconciliation.
Realizes Harima is a dangerous fanatic and tries to subdue him with Raikiri.

periods.time: Kyushu disaster and simultaneous Tokyo defense crisis
periods.label: 以众人之力斩断大炎
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Wakaba House; International Mage-Knight League Japan branch

status.current: defeats Harima Tendo's post-death storm by channeling Kyushu's restored power grid into Raikiri
status.condition: emotionally shaken by Tendo's death-imprint, then stabilized by Nishikata and Wakaba House; physically exhausted after the decisive strike

relationships.harima-tendo: Tendo targets her as a candidate for his so-called grace, breaks her confidence, then becomes the enemy she defeats by rejecting his premise.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Friend who warns and supports her during the evacuation and crisis response.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Close friend from Hagun; injured while saving her from the landslide.
relationships.nishikata-hisako: Wakaba House director and maternal figure who teaches Toka that she may stop forcing herself to be a hero.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Ally who buys time against Tendo and entrusts her with the third-arrow role.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Ally whose frontal assault helps create the opening for Toka's final strike.

periods.summary: Toka initially accompanies Harima Tendo to a graveyard and discovers he is the terrorist called Daien. Tendo overwhelms her with disaster-class magic, forces her to witness Fukuoka being destroyed, and later imprints on her the certainty of her own death if she faces him again. Toka first tries to force an Awakening through fear, but repeated mental deaths break her. Nishikata and the children of Wakaba House remind her that strength can mean accepting help rather than surpassing fate alone. Toka then proposes using Kyushu's restored electrical grid as a collective weapon: civilians repair lines and operate plants, knights protect them, and she receives the power at Central Substation. With that entrusted force she launches herself by electromagnetic repulsion, cuts through Tendo's God Breath and cloud-body with Raikiri, and proves that joined human effort can surpass his false grace.

key_events.summary: Fights Tendo at the graveyard, fails to touch his spirit body, and sees Fukuoka devastated by disaster magic.
Awakens in Miyazaki and learns about Desperado, Brute Soul, Excessive Awakening, and Tendo's history.
Tendo's gravity shows her a repeated crucifixion-death vision and she nearly collapses under the obligation to awaken.
Asks civilians, engineers, knights, and shelters to fight together by restoring the Kyushu grid.
Uses Kyushu's combined electricity to destroy Tendo's remnant and clear the storm.

periods.label: 雷切参与红莲皇女救援
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy student council; Union Japan rescue team

status.volume_role: high-speed assault member and rear-guard against Abrahams

personality.summary: Touka stays composed even amid family conflict and urgency. She accepts the rescue order, applies battlefield judgment, and uses her speed and lightning to neutralize threats far above ordinary student level.
values: not wasting time on internal conflict
flaws: can only watch as Kurogane family tensions erupt before Itsuki clarifies his order

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Junior and rescue leader by emotional stake; she supports his mission and later protects the route.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Fights beside him against Abraham clones; recognizes their shared natural-interference ability to draw external energy.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Protects him from Abraham's surprise attack and fights with him as rear support.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend/comrade to be rescued; later a possessed threat whose blast leaves Touka unconscious.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Her victory over PSYON is referenced; Touka compares Abraham strength to what Kurono overcame.

periods.summary: Touka is present when Ikki wakes and learns Stella has been abducted. Itsuki orders her onto the rescue team, trusting her near-A-class capability after the Kyushu incident. At the Nikko site she slices through fortified mercenaries with Raioh, disassembles a Large EDY by racing across its joints with Shippu Jinrai, and uses Reverse Sight to check an apparently empty fourth-floor battlefield. Abraham clones ambush the team; Touka protects Alice but is injured, then draws power from the laboratory wiring to become a lightning-like combatant and cut down one Abraham with Raikiri. Along with Ouma and Alice she holds the Abrahams while Ikki and Shizuku continue downward. She later survives possessed Stella's destructive blast thanks in part to Ouma's protection.

key_events.summary: Is assigned by Itsuki as one of the official rescue members.
Destroys mercenary fortifications and a Large EDY with lightning speed.
Cuts down an Abraham and joins the rear-guard fight on the fourth floor.
